_comment: Per-tenant rules agreed with stakeholders that are STRICTER than the workflow policy the simulator enforces (SUBMISSION.md section 3). Loaded at startup by controller.governance.load_overrides; unknown keys or wrong types fail fast. Set CTL_TENANT_OVERRIDES to another file, or to 'none' to run on platform policy alone. A tenant not listed here gets plain policy.

kestrel_finance._source: stakeholders/04 (Anita Desai): max 2 requests a day, nothing before 11:00, notice before changes on a running campaign

northwind_life._source: stakeholders/02 (Meera Iyer): no customer-facing change without a named human approval
